description:
Read an audit's stored results per prompt and engine (brand URL cited or named, competitors cited or named, cited URLs), summary rates, the playbook's top actions and a shareable report_url. Asks no engine.

Billing: free (works at a zero balance).

When to call: before paying for new checks, to see where competitors are cited instead (list_sites' latest_audit.audit_id, or any tool's audit_id); then get_fix_plan.

Inputs: audit_id; only_lost — only answered cells without the brand's URL; prompt — only prompts containing this text; max_urls — per cell, default 5 (0–50; brand and competitor URLs always listed); include_answers — adds answer_excerpt.

Returns { audit_id, brand, domain, status, created_at, engines, prompt_count, competitor_domains, competitor_domains_added_since?, visibility_score, failure_reason, partial_errors?, report_url, charged_cents, charged_breakdown_cents, summary: {answered, total, cited, mentioned, citation_rate, mention_rate, prompts_lost, by_engine, competitors: [{domain, cited_cells, cited_where_brand_not}], top_cited_domains, top_competitors_mentioned: [{name, cells}], suggested_competitor_domains: [{domain, cells}], suggested_sources: [{domain, cells, kind}]}, do_this_first?: [{priority, title, description, closes_lost_cells, target_hosts}], results: [{prompt, engines: [{engine, status, cited, mentioned, competitors_cited, competitors_mentioned, urls, more_urls?, answer_excerpt?}]}], suggested_next?, next_step? }. An unanswered cell is {engine, status, error}. summary covers every cell; filters narrow only results. A running audit shows answers so far. do_this_first: the playbook's top 3 actions (already billed; once written). competitor_domains: the run's list plus ones added since. A complete audit with some failed engine calls has partial_errors, not a failure_reason. suggested_competitor_domains: untracked hosts cited where the brand wasn't that the answers name (confirm before add_site); suggested_sources: the rest (directory|publisher|forum|source), places to earn a mention.

include_answers.description: true: add a ~320-char answer_excerpt per cell.

max_urls.description: Cited URLs listed per cell (default 5); the brand's and competitors' URLs are always listed.

only_lost.description: true: only answered cells where the brand's URL was not cited.

name: get_audit
title: Read an audit's per-prompt, per-engine citation results
